name: Oviya Pashiri
description: Oviya Pashiri, called Grandmother Pashiri, is an elderly renegade lifecrafter and inventor on Kaladesh, an old family friend of Chandra and Ajani's ally.

description_citations.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.
"Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

summary.text: Oviya Pashiri, called Grandmother Pashiri, is an elderly renegade lifecrafter and inventor on Kaladesh, an old family friend of Chandra and Ajani's ally.

citations.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.
"Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

bio.text: She comforted Chandra and vowed to help free her mother from the Consulate.

citations.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

bio.text: She brought Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party and asked Yahenni about Pia's capture, and then led them to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lay in tunnels beneath it.

citations.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.
"Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

bio.text: Baral trapped her with Chandra and Nissa in a sealed chamber that filled with poison vapor.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

bio.text: Ajani found her barely breathing and healed her poisoned blood, and later led them out.

citations.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.
"Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.
"Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

bio.text: She reunited with the Gatewatch and later gave Pia's team a crate containing a weapon against the turret while mobilizing renegade inventors.

citations.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.
"Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

bio.text: Thopter lightning struck her on the Hub platform after Baral ordered her taken out, and Ajani healed her.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
"Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

status.text: As of the latest story she is alive, healed by Ajani after being struck by thopter lightning.

citations.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri tells Yahenni that Pia Nalaar has been captured and asks what he knows.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was captured, you know.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri leave at once to find Pia.
timeline.quote: We need to go now,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
timeline.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts a steel door's handle with white-hot fire.
timeline.quote: A blast of white-hot fire leapt from Chandra's hand to engulf the door handle

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra kicks down a guard while Nissa's vines dismantle his automaton.
timeline.quote: Vines broke through the concrete floor and coiled around its legs

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
timeline.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
timeline.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
timeline.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
timeline.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
timeline.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani wears mechanical gauntlets made for him by Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request while infiltrating Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: They'd been crafted by the Glint-Sleeves, a group that specialized in such bodily attachments.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
timeline.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
timeline.quote: I don't kill.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani follows Grandmother's attar scent across the city like a tracker.
timeline.quote: It was a different kind of jungle, but he was a tracker.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: At the safe house Tamni tells Ajani that Consulate men with a false-armed leader arrested Pia and that Mrs. Pashiri led two women toward Kujar.
timeline.quote: when I got there, the Consulate had her surrounded

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
timeline.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
timeline.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Grandmother Pashiri's poisoned blood.
timeline.quote: burning away the black, filling her blood with clean air

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
timeline.quote: We have a ride,

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
timeline.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: At the party, Yahenni announces their will, leaving half their savings to their aetherborn family and the rest to inventor Sana Ahir.
timeline.quote: "My other half of savings goes to you, red-scarf-wearing human inventor in the corner!"

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
timeline.quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
timeline.quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

relations.note: He calls her Grandmother and is helped by her.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

relations.note: He rescued her and she calls him a good man.
relations.quote: That was a very good thing you did, Ajani.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.
"Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

relations.note: Ajani calls her Grandmother and heals her.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

pages_say.description: A robed older woman who comforts Chandra and promises to help rescue her mother.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

pages_say.description: A famous inventor and board game enthusiast who brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

pages_say.description: An older renegade inventor and old friend of Chandra's parents who leads the search through Ghirapur's night market and tunnels.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

pages_say.description: An elderly renegade lifecrafter and inventor who has had Ajani's gauntlets and cloak made and is trapped in the Dhund's poison chamber.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

pages_say.description: An older renegade ally of Chandra who is saved by Ajani and supported by his fur.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

pages_say.description: A weaker associate of the Gatewatch whom Baan expects them to protect.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

pages_say.description: An old family friend of Chandra who leads her and Nissa to the Dhund.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

pages_say.description: A friend of the renegades who is with Ajani at the receiving line for grocery rations.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

pages_say.description: An old lifecrafter who provides the gremlin-filled crate and mobilizes renegades.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

pages_say.description: A friend who inherits Yahenni's Fleetwheel Cruiser and advises Chandra.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

pages_say.description: A lifecrafter who is struck by thopter lightning and left unconscious but alive.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.
